desc: Derive the parity-assignment reduction from original pairings.
Prove via parity-preserving exchange that an optimum uses at most two cakes outside the top \(2K\) by \(M_i=\max(X_i,Y_i,Z_i)\).
Derive the constant-state DP over top-\(2K\) omissions and arbitrary outside-cake selections.
Verify parity handling, ties, duplicates, boundary cases, and zero values.
Implement the \(O(N\log N)\) solution; it passed all public samples.
